summary: Validated Heroku DEPLOYMENT bug fix. Ran `alembic upgrade head` on a fresh throwaway Postgres DB from /app — exit 0, all expected tables created, alembic_version='0001_initial', partial unique index uq_credit_tx_paypal_order present. pyproject.toml + uv.lock both contain all 13 required runtime deps (alembic, sqlalchemy, asyncpg, authlib, pyjwt, itsdangerous, psycopg2-binary, python-multipart, pypdf2, python-docx, python-pptx, pillow). Regression: 22/22 tests in test_monetization.py PASSED. Backend /api/health OK on external HTTPS URL; dev-login + /api/auth/me works; council_session cookie is HttpOnly + Secure.
seed_data_creation: Throwaway DB tmp_alembic_test_7018 created and dropped for migration verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deployment/dependency fix verified end-to-end. Heroku `release: alembic upgrade head` should now succeed since uv buildpack will install alembic from root pyproject.toml/uv.lock. All 22 monetization regression tests still green.
rca of the issue: Root cause was Heroku's uv buildpack resolving deps only from /app/pyproject.toml (which was missing runtime deps present in backend/requirements.txt). Fix: added all runtime deps to root pyproject.toml + regenerated uv.lock. Verified by running alembic on a fresh DB using the venv installed via that same lock file.
